answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one rule: identity is minted only by burning work that cannot be copied or transferred, so every extra agent costs a fresh bond plus its own compute. Because the bond locks to the human staker, a thousand clones from one staker collapse into one seat. Reaching a tenth of the beacon weight would cost an attacker a thousand times the honest stake and the same in power. Reputation is the summit each clone climbs from zero. Past a capital floor the gain vanishes and the terrace stays flat.
